newsitem.title: USA: James River to redeem preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: James River to redeem preferred stock.

text.p: James River Corp said it will redeem all of the outstanding shares and related depositary shares of its Series P nine percent cumulative convertible preferred stock.
The Series P preferred stock will be redeemed using common stock at a conversion ratio of .9206 shares of common stock for each Series P depositary share.
All of the approximately 16.5 million outstanding Series P depositary shares will be redeemed for 15.2 million James River common shares, the company said.
James River said that the redemption will reduce its aggregate cash dividends by $16.5 million per year. ((New York newsroom 212 859 1700))
